physics_note: secondaries killed at creation; primary-only transport for transmission counting
sampling: table-driven: protocol lambda_open row weights (Guan-normalized, surrogate convention) + real-EcoMug momentum spectra; backtracked line of sight, uniform panel impact
reference_histogram: kinetic energy at the counting plane > 3 GeV

source_definition.injection: last sampled interior point of cone plus 1 m, backward ray sampled every 0.5 m up to 4 km; 1 m before panel when no intersection sampled
source_definition.azimuth: uniform over -35 to +35 degrees relative to view direction
source_definition.elevation: original row weights within nominal range, linear extrapolation of eight edge rows outside; clamp negative weights to zero and centers below 0.1 degrees to zero
source_definition.momentum: piecewise linear interpolation of 257 inverse-CDF quantiles in 16 elevation bands; nearest edge band outside table range
source_definition.observable: primary directional synthetic counts; no claim of finite detector equivalence

normalization.threshold_convention_to_resolve: S0 inherited numeric convention only; not used as generator energy cutoff or calibrated physical duration
normalization.diagnostic_reference: ideal tabulated no-transport source; not measured open-sky flux

wall_seconds_semantics: sum of block wall times; not campaign elapsed time
energy_mean_note: all-energy weighted mean when available; selected-energy mean unavailable
npz_contract: oe1-image-az-edges-v1: counts_ref uint32 plus explicit angular centers/edges
